segments.text: A useful AI prompt can still miss the written control that keeps a sensitive action in review.
This fictional support prompt stays in the browser while CrewScore checks the public written controls.
It found twenty of twenty-three written guardrails. Three controls may be missing.
Review the exact wording before adding it. Select only the control this prompt actually needs.
The selected wording is added only in this browser, then rescored. Now twenty-one controls are written down.
Share the control summary if you need to, not the prompt. CrewScore finds missing written guardrails; it does not prove runtime safety.
